author: MarioNawfal
text:
🚨🇺🇸 BREAKING: Every major network, Fox included, stopped filming Trump over his press ban, and the White House is reportedly launching its own TV

ABC, CBS, NBC, CNN and even FOX stopped filming the president Monday, and Trump answered with an AI image of their logos stuffed in trash bags.

Trump TV will look fantastic at rallies, but nobody on that payroll is pointing a camera at the moments the White House would rather skip, and a country at war needs somebody who will.

Source: Axios, The Washington Post / Writer: Daniel
